pages.body_html:
Girls Select ("we," "our," or "us"), a brand operated under Allipse Ecom LLC, is committed to protecting the privacy and security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy outlines how we collect, use, store, and disclose the information we gather when you use our website, communicate with us, or purchase from us.

1. Information We Collect

We collect both personal and non-personal information when you engage with our website or place an order. This includes:

  • Your name, email address, phone number, and shipping/billing address

  • Order details and payment information (securely processed through third-party providers)

  • Communications via email, chat, or social media

  • IP address, device type, browser information, and browsing behavior for analytics

2. How We Use Your Information

We may use your information to:

  • Process and fulfill orders

  • Provide customer support and updates

  • Improve our website, services, and product offerings

  • Send promotional offers (only with your consent)

  • Detect and prevent fraud or suspicious activity

3. Sharing of Information

We only share your data with trusted third-party service providers, such as:

  • Payment processors

  • Shipping and logistics companies

  • Email and SMS service platforms

We do not sell, rent, or disclose your personal information to any unrelated third parties.

4. Data Security

We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your data. All payment information is encrypted and handled securely by third-party platforms. Access to your personal information is restricted to authorized personnel only.

5. Your Rights

You may request to:

  • Access or update your personal data

  • Withdraw your consent for marketing

  • Request deletion of your stored information (where applicable by law)

To do so, contact us at: support@sirasculpt.com

6. Changes to This Policy

We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting on this page.

We want you to love what you buy at Girls Select. If for any reason you’re not satisfied with your purchase, we're here to help.

1. Eligibility for Refunds or Exchanges

To be eligible, please notify us within 3 days of receiving your item. We will accept refunds or exchanges for the following reasons:

  • Product is defective or damaged upon delivery

  • You received the wrong item

  • Item has a clear functional issue

Conditions:

  • Item must be unused and in its original condition

  • Original packaging must be intact

  • Photo or video proof must be provided

We reserve the right to deny refund or exchange requests that do not meet our criteria.

2. Non-Refundable Items

We do not offer refunds or exchanges for:

  • Products purchased under clearance or final sale

  • Used beauty or hygiene products

  • Change of mind after delivery

3. Refund Process

Once your refund request is approved:

  • Refunds are issued to your original payment method or via store credit

  • Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days

For cash-on-delivery orders, eligible refunds will be provided via mobile wallets or bank deposit.

1. Processing Time

  • Orders are packed and dispatched within 1–2 business days after confirmation

  • Orders placed on weekends or public holidays may experience slight delays

2. Delivery Timeframe

Delivery may take between 2–7 business days, depending on your location and delivery service availability.

We are not responsible for delays caused by:

  • Unreachable customer phone numbers

  • Incorrect address entry at checkout

  • Force majeure (weather, strikes, natural disasters)

3. Delivery Partners

We work with trusted logistics partners to ensure safe and timely delivery. A tracking number or delivery confirmation will be shared whenever applicable.

4. Shipping Charges

Shipping charges (if any) will be calculated and displayed at checkout. Offers such as Free Delivery may apply during promotional periods.
